title: Unable to use a stylus to switch to a workspace by touching it to an area with a window
line: Tapping a window in the Pager with a pen now switches to that desktop instead of grabbing the window.
explanation: The Pager's window outlines set drag.threshold: 1, so the outline started a window drag as soon as the pointer moved a single pixel during a press. A pen tap always wobbles a few pixels, so it grabbed the window and the release never switched desktop. The change drops the override so the MouseArea uses the platform's start drag distance, like other drag sources.

commits.message:
applets/pager: Use the system drag threshold for window outlines

Window outlines started a drag after moving a single pixel, so a pen
tap, which always wobbles a little, grabbed the window instead of
switching to its desktop. Use the platform's start drag distance.

BUG: 513474

patches.diff:
From 04d7e63d439c8b824a92a005a725041e7e2cddd3 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:03:14 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: Use the system drag threshold for window
 outlines

Window outlines started a drag after moving a single pixel, so a pen
tap, which always wobbles a little, grabbed the window instead of
switching to its desktop. Use the platform's start drag distance.

BUG: 513474
---
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml | 1 -
 1 file changed, 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..58359e6677 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -524,7 +524,6 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                                 anchors.fill: parent
 
                                 drag.target: windowRect
-                                drag.threshold: 1
                                 drag.axis: Drag.XAndYAxis
                                 drag.minimumX: 0
                                 drag.maximumX: root.width - windowRect.width
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Pager (zoomed) after a tap with 3 px of movement on the window outline on desktop 3: desktop 1 is still active
Same tap with the fix: desktop 3 is active and its window is shown
The wobbly tap on master: the outline is grabbed, no desktop switch
The wobbly tap with the fix: switches to desktop 3

review.text: drag.threshold: 1 was added on purpose in 463b6798ae ('Make drag and drop of pager more reliable', BUG 460541: in a small pager there is no room to move the cursor far enough to start a drag). Going back to the platform start-drag distance brings 460541 back for small pagers, and neither the verification nor the commit message mentions it.
changes: Keep a small threshold that tolerates pen wobble (a few logical px, e.g. Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing) instead of the full platform distance, or only use the larger threshold for tablet/touch input
Recheck 460541 (dragging a window in a small/thin-panel pager) with the change
